description: This PHP source file defines the EducationDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It manages Data Access Object (DAO) operations for 'Education' entities, including CRUD operations, searching, and pagination functionalities.

classes.name: EducationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing 'Education' entities, including CRUD, search, and pagination operations.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Persists an Education entity to the database.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingEducationIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing Education entities matching provided IDs.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its name.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Education entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEducationListPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator object for Education list based on search filters.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Education entities matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Performs soft deletion of Education entities by IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks if an Education name already exists in the database.
